notes: Account: large regulated fintech building an enterprise IDE copilot for engineering org. Priority: prevent source-code exfil and have provable audit trail. Key quote from CTO: "we cannot risk any unexplained network egress or third-party storage of snippets". Technical asks: VPC/private control plane, optional on-prem agent for air-gapped builds, customer-managed KMS for token + model artifacts, SSO/SAML + SCIM, audit logs with token-level request_id mapping, retention controls for logs and prompts (90-365 days negotiable). Performance targets: low-latency streaming for IDE (target <20ms median per token end-to-end for JetBrains plugin; <15ms for internal web editor), sustaining 1k concurrent developers with burst to 3k. Model requirements: pinning per-team to approved model versions, automatic fallback to quantized variants on capacity constraints, deterministic rollouts and canary with easy rollback. Cost sensitivity: high — need a cost/runbook showing token-level unit economics for 1M daily tokens. POC notes: VS Code + internal JetBrains plugin tested for 3 weeks (Dec 2025) — median streaming latency 18–22ms in private VPC test, quality OK on small codebases but need reranking for suggestion relevance. Security review: answered initial questionnaire, outstanding items on KMS key rotation, HSM options, and penetration test reports. Procurement: legal requested infra addendum for indemnity and data residency; SOW draft in progress. Next: network design call with infra (week of 2026-03-08), finalize SOW, legal sign-off, then pilot expansion to 200 devs. CRM shorthand: POC Succeeded (small), security deep dive required, procurement timeline conservative (Q2).
